mini_agent 2.0.0 turns the small agent from AgentForge Tutorial 1 into a command-line tool
that installs with one command on macOS, Linux and Windows. See "Install on your computer"
in the README.

What is new

- One-command install. `mini_agent setup` chooses a provider and stores your key;
  `mini_agent doctor` shows what is set up and what is missing.
- Many providers behind one interface: OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI,
  Google Gemini, Alibaba Qwen, any OpenAI-compatible server, and a local Ollama server.
- Your own tools: write a Python function, add `@tool`, and give it to the agent.
- On the command line the agent asks before shell commands, Python code and file writes,
  and its file tools stay inside the folder it works in.
- Long tasks: the agent keeps your messages and a handoff note in `.mini_agent/` in that
  folder, and shortens old steps when a prompt would fill more than half of the model's
  context window. `mini_agent -c` continues a task that stopped, crashed or was
  interrupted, in the folder it ran in, without running a cut-off tool call twice.
- Rate limits, server errors and timeouts are retried; a wrong key stops at once and says
  what to check.
- `--keep-alive` keeps a long task going: when the provider cannot be reached or the
  process is killed, it waits and continues the same task. It stops at once on anything
  that waiting will not fix: the task is done, a risky call needs approval, the budget is
  used up, a wrong key, or Ctrl+C. The README shows how to start it again when the computer
  restarts, on macOS and Linux. Only one mini_agent process works on a session at a time.
- The exit status tells scripts how a task ended: 0 the agent finished, 1 it stopped
  before the end, 2 a usage or set-up error, 3 a risky call needs approval, 4 the session
  is in use by another mini_agent process, 75 `--keep-alive` gave up because several
  continues in a row made no progress, 130 interrupted.

Tutorial notebooks

- The Tutorial 1 and Tutorial 2 Colab notebooks install this release. Offline mode replays
  the same recorded runs as before. Copies of the notebooks saved before this release keep
  installing version 1.2.2.

Worth knowing when you upgrade

- Session logs are now kept in `~/.mini_agent/sessions`, with your settings and notes.
- Notes and the daily log are now in `~/.mini_agent/memory`. Version 1.2.2 kept them in a
  `mem` folder next to the package (or at the root of a source checkout), and they are not
  moved: copy `long_term.md` into `~/.mini_agent/memory` to keep your notes.
- In Python, an `Agent`'s file tools only reach paths inside its workspace;
  `Agent(confine=False)` lifts that. `Agent` runs every tool without asking unless you pass
  `approve="ask"`.
